intro: Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome who talks like a pirate captain, found stranded along the foggy shoreline of Mist's Edge in northern Darkshore. His ship was sunk offshore by threshadons, and he wants his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, back in working order.

p: Perched on the desolate northern coast of Darkshore just west of the ancient Ruins of Mathystra, Gelkak Gyromast represents a peculiar sight among the gloomy night elven shores. Talking like an old sea dog, the self-styled captain lost his ship to the threshadons just offshore. When he washed up on the misty sands, the key to his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, broke on the rocks, and its pieces were carried off by the crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs rummaging through the wreckage.
